title: Chili
paragraphs: Thai cuisine balances spicy, sweet, sour, and salty flavors, often in a single dish. Bird’s-eye chilies (prik kee noo) are small but very hot on the Scoville scale.

In Thailand, chilies are used fresh, dried, roasted, and as pastes, adjusting heat at the table with prik nam pla (chilies in fish sauce). Their heat is balanced by herbs like Thai basil and cooling ingredients like lime and cucumber.
